title: Briefverkehr der Stadt St. Gallen 1400-1650: Digitale Missivenedition
author: Correspondents of the city of St. Gall
institution: Stadtarchiv und Vadianische Sammlung der Ortsbürgergemeinde St. Gallen
notes: Full text and images of incoming letters (Missiven) to the imperial city of St. Gall, published in stages. The site lists 760 dated letters (1417-1651, 228,746 words); 218 are before 1450. Counts are our own, from the TEI of each letter (served at /api/document/<id>, e.g. stasg_missiv_00300): 542 letters dated 1450-1651 and about 175,000 words of letter text. The letter list is at the data link. Status active: the site presents a 'Missive des Monats' every first Friday of the month.
